production.canonicalMetadataSource: Authenticated project and D1 captures in the successful trusted-main workflow; not an independent connector resource GET.

limits: This live release exercised immediate convergence (one version GET); deterministic fixtures establish polling and deadline behavior.
Authenticated capture and public HTTP checks are separate reads, not an atomic transaction or guarantee against later edits.
Private baselines remain ignored and were not uploaded; the artifact contains only the sanitized report.
No new physical-device, real credential/CAPTCHA, book-opening or provider-write acceptance is claimed.
